why: The large r/hellointernet defence-and-repair item mixes attack alarms with cleaning and fixing, so the line between fighting an attack and routine repair is the hardest to draw.

why.T3-145: The concepts read love of national flags from the canvas, voicing national feeling through the state of the flags; not T3-085 because they are not weighing the room's own art against nations.

why.T3-082: Members point out room-relevant marks already present or being built on the canvas, fitting finding the room's mark placed rather than celebrating their own finished work.

why.T3-031: The single code is a joke about the room's vandalized Grey face, playing the room's own humour in canvas talk rather than decoding a picture's general meaning.

why.T3-005: The dominant concepts are attack alarms, calls to defend, and holding the line against blues, rainbows, and rival flags.
why.T3-021: A substantial set of concepts is plain watching, fixing, maintenance, and cleaning of the work, distinct from fighting an attack.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005 carries the fight against attackers but not the maintenance and repair routines when no attack is called, such as cleaning and fixing a vandalized Brady.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-021's gate is watching and repairing the work, supported by C1191192, a call to fix a vandalized Brady.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-021; dropping it would lose the ordinary repair and cleaning work that is not defence against an attack.

why.T3-044: An outsider was led to the sub by its canvas icon and asks what the community is, which is the recruiting-canvas-visitors gate.

why.T3-117: The concepts register that r/place has ended and express regret at the close, fitting marking the canvas's end rather than mourning a specific lost work.

why.T3-054: Both concepts are about moving to an r/place replacement or clone after the original closes, exactly carrying work to a new canvas.

why.T3-027: The concepts argue that scripts are unfair to the fun and collaborative spirit, which is the fairness-of-scripts gate, not running a script.

why.T3-028: The single concept is adapting a script to automatically draw for the canvas, which is running scripts for the work.

why.T3-010: The item is a broad coexistence bag whose best single gate is settling borders and space with neighbours; also present at the three-concept floor are T3-024, T3-040, T3-119, T3-011, and T3-122.

why.T3-009: Most concepts are congratulations, pride, and celebrating that the Tims made their mark.
why.T3-043: Several concepts specifically credit the collective or individual makers, such as recognising more than one fan and calling them a great nation of Tims.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 celebrates the finished work but does not carry the specific crediting of who made it.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: T3-043's gate is crediting who made the work, supported by C0685049 recognising that more than one fan made the mark.
